newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCIBank 3-mth net ended Dec 681 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PCIBank 3-mth net ended Dec 681 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine Commercial International Bank (PCIBank) said on Wednesday its net income in the fourth quarter ended December 31, 1996 amounted to 681.262 million pesos.
The bank did not provide comparative figures for the year-ago quarter.

The bank also did not furnish figures for the whole of 1996. But based on the nine-month net profit of 2.173 billion pesos it announced in November, last year's net income would amount to about 2.854 billion pesos.
PCIBank president Rafael Buenaventura said last month the bank expected net income in 1996 to reach 2.8 billion pesos from 2.36 billion pesos in 1995.
PCIBank said total operating income reached 3.948 billion pesos in the three months, of which 2.989 billion pesos was interest income.
Interest expenses in the three months amounted to 1.432 billion pesos and other operating expenses, 1.817 billion pesos.
